name: Jiangxi Black Cat Carbon Black Inc.,Ltd
summary: Jiangxi Black Cat Carbon Black Inc.,Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells carbon black products in China. It operates through Carbon Black, Tar Refining, and Other segments. The company offers carbon black for rubber, special carbon black, green carbon black, precipitated and fumed silica, and chemical products; and tar refining and white carbon black products.
